limits: Historical validators are never executed. Only fixed read-only check/selftest commands run; no command is executed from an evidence file.

Filed rounds 8-19 are compared byte-for-byte against the declared baseline; any change, addition or removal under those directories fails closed. Git-ignored untracked files (the `*.log` rule) are recorded, never failed.

The uncertainty, D4-link, contract-audit and README checks are structural: vocabulary, basis presence, link resolution against the worktree, dated command-carried receipts and row/file agreement. They do not certify the truth of any claim; all artifacts remain NON-CANON.
The shape gate result is the packet's own gate reading; 16/16 + 20/20 is shape, not semantic conformance, lore review, or a transfer acceptance.

The delivered exercise revision is single-profile (its default baseline is the round-20 v3 baseline); the harness measures the default run as the v3 path and, when a revision exposes --profile, measures the explicit profile runs too.

The v2 path is measured by replaying its round-20 successor baseline row (expected-v2-07-*.json) through the filed round-15 frozen-verify.py; the v2 packet bytes themselves are covered by the filed-rounds freeze.
The d3 leg is the D3 family assembler check; the projector has no D3 label surface (its D3-packet probe is recorded informationally, never as a pass).
A declared-vs-live count delta is accepted only when the README names it; the harness never rewrites a declared claim to match the tree.
